# Size results (generated by run_size.py)

Test set: 10987 events, 378 batches (mean 29.1 ev/batch), installs=10, profile=base. Unit: bytes per event of the HTTP body (sum of compressed bodies / events). Dictionaries trained on seed=2 only.

| V1 JSON (exact current) | 838.1 | 112.8 | 97.0 | 94.5 | 82.1 | 77.3 | 90.0 | 84.8 | 72.1 | 62.1 | 61.8 |

Baseline = V1 JSON gzip-1 = 112.8 B/event (SDK uses CompressionLevel.Fastest).

Reduction vs baseline for selected cells:

- V1 JSON (exact current) / gzip-6: 97.0 B/event, 14.0% smaller
- V1 JSON (exact current) / br-11: 77.3 B/event, 31.4% smaller
- V1 JSON (exact current) / zstd-19+dict16K: 62.1 B/event, 44.9% smaller
- V1 JSON all JSON-level opts / gzip-6: 54.4 B/event, 51.7% smaller
- V1 JSON all JSON-level opts / zstd-19+dict16K: 31.2 B/event, 72.3% smaller
- Protobuf typed (codegen) / zstd-19+dict16K: 27.7 B/event, 75.4% smaller
- MTB2 columnar / gzip-6: 42.4 B/event, 62.4% smaller
- MTB2 columnar / zstd-19+dict16K: 22.7 B/event, 79.8% smaller
- MTB2 columnar + CAS ctx/shape cache / zstd-19+dict16K min-frame: 22.0 B/event, 80.4% smaller

## 8. Server response size per batch (B/event)

- V1 JSON response, raw: 44.8; gzip-6: 27.8
- MTB2 ack (spec 7.2: 1 B status + varint first_seq + varint count + varint server_time_delta + policy_epoch) ~ 8-12 B per batch = 0.34 B/event (computed, not encoded here)
